mathematical_meanings: Left image: The dotted arc is a planar construction guide through A and P. Right image: The dashed arc represents the hidden portion of the rim of the cylinder’s right end.
Rationales: The feature represents an auxiliary arc in a plane construction in the left image and shows the occluded part of the circular rim of a solid in the right image. The dotted arc from the vicinity of A descending through P. The dashed arc on the back half of the right cylinder end.
